extensionName.description: Name of the extension, shown in the browser's extension list.

extensionDescription.message: Automatically likes YouTube videos from the channels you choose.
extensionDescription.description: Short description of the extension, shown in the browser's extension list.

locale.description: Language code of this translation (BCP 47), used to format numbers and dates like the texts.

switchLabel.description: Accessible name of the on/off switch of the extension.

switchActive.description: State shown next to the switch when the extension is on.

switchPaused.description: State shown next to the switch when the extension is off.

pausedBanner.message: The extension likes nothing while it is paused.

badgeUpdate.description: Badge on the toolbar icon when a new version is out; 4 characters at most.

updateAvailableTitle.message: YouTube Auto Like: version $VERSION$ is out
updateAvailableTitle.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon when a new version is out.

updateFooter.description: Link to the release page, in place of the version number at the bottom of the popup.

sectionThisVideo.description: Heading of the popup section about the video in the current tab.

sectionThisChannel.description: Heading of the popup section about the channel page in the current tab.

sectionRule.description: Heading of the popup section that sums up the settings in one sentence.

noVideo.message: Open a video or a Short on YouTube to see what the extension does with it, or a channel page to choose whether its videos are liked.

noVideoHint.message: If a video is already open, reload its page.
noVideoHint.description: Shown when the current tab did not answer, for instance a YouTube tab opened before the extension was installed.

statusLikedDetail.description: When and how the video was liked, for instance: 12 seconds ago, as soon as it opened.

likedHowAfterWatching.description: For a live stream: how long the user had been watching when it was liked.

statusWaitPercent.message: Will be liked at $PERCENT$% of the video

statusWaitMinutes.message: Will be liked after $MINUTES$ min of playback

statusWaitRandom.message: Will be liked at a random moment

statusWaitBeforeEnd.message: Will be liked just before the end
statusWaitBeforeEnd.description: The video is shorter than the delay set, so it is liked two seconds before its end.

statusWaitDuration.message: Waiting for the length of the video

statusWaitAd.message: Waiting for the ad to end

statusReadingDetail.message: On a Short, YouTube sometimes shows its buttons only once the mouse moves over the video.

statusConfirming.message: Checking that the like went through…

statusFailedTitle.message: The like could not be confirmed

statusFailedDetail.message: The like button did not react. Reload the page to try again.

reasonAlreadyLiked.message: This video already had a like: the extension leaves it as it is.

reasonAlreadyDisliked.message: You disliked this video: the extension leaves it as it is.

reasonSkippedByUser.message: You asked not to like it this time. It may be liked when you watch it again.

reasonVideoExcluded.message: You excluded this video: it is never liked, until you stop excluding it.

reasonNotSubscribed.message: You are not subscribed to this channel. It will be liked if you subscribe.

reasonNotInAlwaysList.message: Only the channels in your “Always like” list are liked.

reasonInNeverList.message: This channel is in your “Never like” list.

reasonShortsOff.message: Shorts are not liked, as set in your settings.

reasonNormalVideosOff.message: Only Shorts are liked, as set in your settings.

statusWouldLike.description: Shown while the extension is paused.

actionSkip.description: Button: do not like the video being watched, for this viewing only; it may be liked when watched again.

actionRestart.description: Button: the video is checked again from the start, as after a reload of the page.

removedLikeRestart.message: You removed the like. Restart for the extension to check this video again.

removedDislikeRestart.message: You removed the dislike. Restart for the extension to check this video again.

likeRemovedNextOpening.message: It will be liked again the next time the video is opened.

likeRemovedAt.message: It will be liked again when playback passes $TIME$ again.

relikeLabel.message: Like again a video whose like I remove

relikeHint.message: When playback passes the planned moment again, so after going back before it; with “As soon as it opens”, the next time the video is opened. Also for a video you had liked yourself.

actionResume.description: Button: the video goes through the usual checks again, and may be liked.

actionExcludeVideo.description: Button: never like this video, until the user takes it out of the excluded videos.

noticeSaveFailed.message: The change could not be saved.

noticeStorageFull.message: The storage of the extension is full: remove channels or excluded videos from your lists, then try again.

noticeLoadFailed.message: The settings could not be read.

noticeListFull.message: This list is full ($COUNT$ entries at most).

noticeNoAnswer.message: The page did not answer. Reload it and try again.

noticeCopyFailed.message: Could not copy: select the text and copy it yourself.

languageHint.message: The browser's, or another one of your choice. A translation to correct? Suggest it on GitHub.

debugHint.message: Keeps a journal of what the extension does, to report a problem: the last 200 steps, with the IDs of the videos watched and the changes to the settings and lists, kept in this browser only. Off, no journal is kept.

aboutInvite.message: To learn more, follow the new versions or suggest an improvement, visit the GitHub repository. A problem? Report it with the button below.

reportHint.message: Describe the problem in the issue that opens on GitHub: this report is attached to help understand it. Read it before sending it; your channel lists are not in it.

reportJournalOne.message: Attach the journal ($COUNT$ entry, with the IDs of the videos watched and the changes to the settings and lists)

reportJournalOther.message: Attach the journal ($COUNT$ entries, with the IDs of the videos watched and the changes to the settings and lists)

reportDebugOff.message: No journal was kept. To attach one: turn the debug mode on in “More”, do again what goes wrong, then come back here.

reportCut.message: The report is too long for the address of the issue: it is shortened there. Copy the full report and paste it in the issue.

addHint.message: Paste links to channels or videos, or @handles, one per line. The extension asks YouTube which channel each one is, as if you opened its page.

addNothing.message: No channel to add: they are all in this list already, or none was found.

addEmpty.message: Paste at least one link or @handle.

addTooMany.message: At most $MAX$ lines at a time.

lookupDuplicate.message: same channel as an earlier line

lookupNotALink.message: neither a link to a YouTube channel or video, nor an @handle

lookupNotFound.message: no such channel or video on YouTube

lookupUnreadable.message: YouTube did not tell the channel. If it was never opened in this browser, open it once and make your cookie choice, then try again

importHint.message: A file exported by the extension, or a list of channel links, one per line. Nothing is saved before “Import”: “Analyze” first shows what will be done.

importPasteHint.message: You can also paste a file or text (Ctrl+V) in this window.

importNotUnderstood.message: This is neither an export of the extension nor a list of links.

importNoSource.message: First choose a file, or paste some text.

importNoPart.message: Check at least one part to import.

importListFull.message: A list would go past $COUNT$ entries: nothing would be imported.

importModeAddNewHint.message: A channel already in a list stays where it is.

importModeFollowHint.message: A channel already there moves to the list the file gives it.

importModeReplaceHint.message: The parts checked become exactly those of the file: what it does not hold is removed.

importConfirmOne.message: I confirm removing $COUNT$ entry missing from the file.

importConfirmOther.message: I confirm removing the $COUNT$ entries missing from the file.

reportNothing.message: Nothing changes: everything is there already.

exportFormatJsonHint.message: Imported back as it is, with the dates and the pictures of the channels.

exportFormatLinksHint.message: One channel link per line, with its name, to read or share. Excluded videos are left out.

noticeImportInvalid.message: This file is not a list exported by YouTube Auto Like.

noticeImportTooBig.message: This file is too large to be a list of channels.

optionsPageTitle.description: Title of the browser tab of the options page.

navSections.description: Accessible name of the menu of the options page.

channelsHint.message: The “Never like” list always comes first.

likeWhatSubscribedHint.message: plus those in my “Always like” list.

likeWhatListHint.message: subscribed or not, nothing else is liked.

videosHint.message: Shorts are recognized even when opened in the regular player.

whenHint.message: A video you like or dislike yourself is never touched.

thresholdAfter.description: Before a threshold: after [50] % of the video, after [2] minutes of playback.

thresholdKeepOne.message: At least one threshold stays checked.

thresholdsHint.message: The first threshold reached triggers the like. A video shorter than that is liked two seconds before its end. On a live stream, only minutes count, from the moment you started watching; without a minutes threshold, it is liked as soon as it opens. Ads are not counted.

randomHint.message: A moment drawn at random in each video. A live stream is liked as soon as it opens.

listsHint.message: Add channels by link or @handle, from the toolbar popup on a video or a channel page, or from the history. A video is excluded from the toolbar popup.

listEmpty.message: No channel in this list. Add some by link or @handle, from the toolbar popup on a video or a channel page, or from the history.

listEmptyVideos.message: No excluded video. To exclude a video, open the toolbar popup while you watch it, then choose “Never like this video”.

listPageSizeLabel.message: Rows shown in the lists and the history

listPageSizeHint.message: The others show with “Show more” or “Show all”. A long list scrolls inside, without making the page longer.

historyHint.message: The last $COUNT$, newest first, kept in this browser only.

historyEmpty.message: No like made by the extension yet.

updatesHint.message: Asks GitHub, where the extension is published; GitHub then sees your IP address.

updateCustomCount.message: Number of minutes, hours or days between two checks

noticeFrequencyInvalid.message: Enter a length from 5 minutes to 30 days.

updateStatusOff.message: New versions are not looked for.

updateStatusUpToDate.message: Checked $WHEN$: you have the latest version.

updateStatusFailed.message: The last check failed $WHEN$; the next one will try again.

noticeCheckFailed.message: The check could not be made.

likeCountHint.message: Since the extension was installed, or since the last reset. Resetting it changes nothing else.

ruleSentence.description: The settings in one sentence, for instance: Likes videos and Shorts from the channels you subscribe to, as soon as they open.

channels.example: from the channels you subscribe to

ruleNothing.message: Likes nothing: videos and Shorts are both switched off.

ruleChannelsSubscribed.message: from the channels you subscribe to

ruleChannelsSubscribedAndList.message: from the channels you subscribe to and those in your “Always like” list

ruleChannelsList.message: from the channels in your “Always like” list

ruleWhenBoth.message: at $PERCENT$% of the video or after $MINUTES$ min of playback, whichever comes first
